facts.statement: Two specimens of Diluvicursor were discovered in 2005 and formally named in early 2018.
facts.quote: The two known specimens, a vertebra and a partial juvenile postcranium discovered in 2005 from the Eumeralla Formation, are known, and they were named in early 2018.

facts.statement: The name Diluvicursor means "flood runner" and refers to the specimen's deposition in a high-energy river environment.
facts.quote: The generic name of the taxon is derived from the Latin diluvi~, meaning "flood" or "deluge", which was chosen in reference to the fact that the type specimen was deposited in a high energy river and the species would have lived in a prehistoric floodplain, and the Latin word cursor, which means "runner".

facts.statement: The species name pickeringi honors David A. Pickering, a notable Australian paleontologist who died while the study was being prepared.
facts.quote: The specific name, pickeringi, is honoring David A. Pickering, who had made notable contributions to palaeontology in Australia, and who died at the time of the preparation of the study.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen consists of an almost complete articulated tail and parts of the lower right leg.
facts.quote: The holotype, NMV P221080, consists of an almost complete articulated tail lacking only the first, second and twelfth tail vertebra, and parts of the lower right leg: the lower end of the shinbone and calfbone, the complete ankle bones, the metatarsus, the first toe and the first phalanges of the second, third and fourth toes.

facts.statement: Researchers hypothesize that the carcass was trapped in plant debris on a tree stump in a deep, high-energy river.
facts.quote: It would have been deposited in a deep and high-energy river, the carcass thought to have been caught in a trap of plant debris on a standing tree stump.

facts.statement: The holotype, an older juvenile, was estimated to be 1.2 meters long, roughly the size of a modern wild turkey.
facts.quote: The holotype individual, thought to be an older juvenile, was estimated to be 1.2 m in length, using the proportions of Hypsilophodon to fill in unknown areas; it has been compared to the size of a modern wild turkey.

facts.statement: Adults are estimated to have been at least 2.3 meters long, comparable to the size of a rhea.
facts.quote: Based on an isolated caudal vertebra, NMV P229456, twice the length of vertebrae from the holotype, adults are estimated to have measured at least 2.3 m long, closer to the size of a rhea, and still small for an ornithopod.

facts.statement: Phylogenetic analysis recovered Diluvicursor as a basal elasmarian and the sister taxon to Anabisetia.
facts.quote: Their results recovered Diluvicursor as a basal elasmarian, as the sister taxon to Anabisetia.

facts.statement: It is debated whether Diluvicursor is synonymous with other small-bodied ornithopods from the same formation due to a lack of overlapping anatomical material.
facts.quote: As such, it is possible that Diluvicursor may be synonymous with any of these other genera, though this is impossible to determine without additional specimens with overlapping material.

facts.statement: Diluvicursor pickeringi lived approximately 113 million years ago during the Albian stage of the Early Cretaceous in what is now Australia.
facts.quote: Diluvicursor pickeringi es la única especie conocida del género extinto Diluvicursor ("corredor del diluvio") de dinosaurio ornitópodo el cual vivió durante la época del Albiense a mediado del periodo Cretácico, hace aproximadamente 113 millones de años, en lo que es hoy Australia.

facts.statement: Diluvicursor reached an approximate length of 2.3 meters.
facts.quote: Este animal alcanzaba aproximadamente 2.3 metros de longitud.

facts.statement: The holotype individual, considered a juvenile subadult, measured about 1.2 meters in length.
facts.quote: El individuo holotipo, el cual se considera que es un juvenil subadulto, mediría unos 1.2 metros de longitud

facts.statement: Its size is comparable to that of an emu.
facts.quote: El tamaño es comparable con el de un ñandú.

facts.statement: Researchers identified several distinctive traits, including ten unique derived features.
facts.quote: Los descriptores lograron establecer varios rasgos distintivos, incluyendo diez autoapomorfias, o rasgos derivados únicos.

facts.statement: In the third to sixth tail vertebrae, the spinous processes are low, not higher than their front-to-back width.
facts.quote: En las vértebras de la cola de la tercera a la sexta, las puntas espinosas son bajas, no más altas que su ancho de adelante hacia atrás.

facts.statement: In the anterior tail vertebrae, the lateral processes are very wide, equal to 85% of the total vertebral height including the keel.
facts.quote: En las vértebras de la cola delantera, las nervaduras de la cola o las protuberancias laterales son muy anchas, igual al 85% de la altura total de las vértebras, incluido el galón.

facts.statement: The first phalanx of the fourth toe is strongly asymmetric from above when the phalanx is considered flat on the ground.
facts.quote: La primera falange del cuarto dedo del pie es fuertemente asimétrica desde arriba, cuando se piensa que la falange es plana en el suelo

facts.statement: In the middle tail vertebrae, the body is inclined at an angle of 30 degrees with the vertical plane backwards.
facts.quote: En las vértebras de la cola media, el cuerpo está inclinado en un ángulo de 30 ° con el plano vertical hacia atrás.

facts.statement: The exact number of tail vertebrae is unknown.
facts.quote: El número exacto de vértebras de la cola es desconocido.

facts.statement: Remains of Diluvicursor were discovered in 2005 in the Eumeralla Formation.
facts.quote: Los restos de Diluvicursor fueron descubiertos en 2005 en la formación Eumeralla

facts.statement: The discovery was reported in scientific literature in 2009 by Thomas Rich and colleagues.
facts.quote: El hallazgo fue reportado en 2009 en la literatura científica por Thomas Rich y colaboradores.

facts.statement: The holotype, NMV P221080, consists of an almost complete articulated tail missing only the first, second, and twelfth caudal vertebrae.
facts.quote: El holotipo, NMV P221080, consiste una cola casi completa y articulada a la que solo le faltan la primera, segunda y duodécima vértebras caudales

facts.statement: Specimen NMV P229456, a partial tail vertebra of a larger individual found nearby in the same deposit, was also referred to this taxon.
facts.quote: El espécimen NMV P229456, una vértebra parcial de la cola de un individuo mayor, hallado cerca en el mismo depósito, fue también referido a este taxón.

facts.statement: The specimens were described and named digitally via the ZooBank registry in January 2018.
facts.quote: Los especímenes fueron descritos y nombrados digitalmente, a través del uso del registro en ZooBank, en enero de 2018

facts.statement: It lived during the early Albian stage in Victoria, southeastern Australia, near Cape Otway.
facts.quote: la cual data del inicio de la época del Albiense, en Victoria al sureste de Australia en la playa de Cape Otway

facts.statement: The carcass was likely dragged by a current and quickly deposited in a thick layer of mud, where it became entangled in tree trunks.
facts.quote: El cadáver habría sido arrastrado por la corriente y rápidamente depositado en una gruesa capa de lodo. Cerca de la carcasa se encuentran troncos de los árboles en la roca y el animal se habría enredado en ellos.

facts.statement: It is debated whether Diluvicursor is identical to Atlascopcosaurus, though evidence suggests at least two ornithischians were present at the site.
facts.quote: Diluvicursor podría ser idéntico a Atlascopcosaurus , encontrado en la misma formación, pero una vértebra desviada de la cola, NMV P228342, muestra que al menos dos Ornithischia estaban presentes en el lugar.

facts.statement: The genus name Diluvicursor was chosen because the type specimen was found in a high-energy river.
facts.quote: El nombre del género de este taxón se deriva del latín diluvi~, que significa "diluvio" o "inundación", el cual fue escogido en referencia al hecho de que el espécimen tipo fue depositado en un río de alta energía

facts.statement: The genus name includes the Latin word cursor, meaning runner.
facts.quote: la palabra latina cursor, la cual significa "corredor".

facts.statement: The species name pickeringi honors David A. Pickering, a notable Australian paleontologist who died before the study was prepared.
facts.quote: El nombre de la especie, pickeringi es en honor de David A. Pickering, quien realizó notables contribuciones a la paleontología en Australia, y falleció por la época en que se realizaba la preparación del estudio.

facts.statement: Cladistic analysis places Diluvicursor within Cerapoda.
facts.quote: Diluvicursor en un análisis cladístico básicamente cae en Cerapoda.

facts.statement: Descriptives considered the placement of Diluvicursor among Euornithopoda to be tentative.
facts.quote: La ubicación entre los Euornithopoda fue, por lo tanto, considerada por los descriptores como tentativa.

facts.statement: Traditional comparative methods suggest Diluvicursor is related to Anabisetia, Gasparinisaura, the family Dryosauridae, and possibly the Antarctic dinosaur Morrosaurus.
facts.quote: La aplicación del método comparativo tradicional sugiere una relación con Anabisetia, Gasparinisaura, la familia Dryosauridae y tal vez un dinosaurio de la Antártida, tan cerca de Australia en esa época, Morrosaurus.

facts.statement: The parent group of Diluvicursor is Elasmaria.
facts.quote: Parent group: Elasmaria

facts.statement: Diluvicursor belongs to the class Ornithischia.
facts.quote: Class: Ornithischia

facts.statement: Diluvicursor lived during the Albian stage, between 113.2 and 110.1 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Albian to Albian (113.2 to 110.1 million years ago)

facts.statement: Diluvicursor was likely a plant-eater.
facts.quote: Diluvicursor era probablemente un comedor de plantas.

facts.statement: The small Diluvicursor ate low vegetation including Pteridophyta, Hepaticae, Lycopsida, Cycadophyta, Bennettitales, and Taeniopteridae.
facts.quote: El pequeño Diluvicursor no comía nada de esto, sino plantas de una vegetación más baja consistente en Pteridophyta, Hepaticae, Lycopsida, Cycadophyta, Bennettitales y los tan típicos Taeniopteridae.

facts.statement: A low tail base indicates a special form of movement for Diluvicursor.
facts.quote: La base de la cola baja indica una forma especial de movimiento.

facts.statement: Researchers suggest that the widening of muscles likely improved walking ability by allowing the femur to be pushed back with greater force.
facts.quote: El ensanchamiento probablemente condujo a una mejor capacidad para caminar porque la masa muscular aumentada podría empujar el fémur hacia atrás con más fuerza.

facts.statement: Diluvicursor is larger than the more recent ornithischians found at Dinosaur Cove.
facts.quote: Eso explicaría porqué Diluvicursor es más grande que los ornistisquios más recientes de Dinosaur Cove.
